description: This file defines the 'ShopProductPriceFormatTag' class, a custom JSP tag for formatting product prices based on currency and store settings.

classes.name: ShopProductPriceFormatTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag extending RequestContextAwareTag to format product prices with optional currency, using injected services.

methods.name: doStartTagInternal
methods.description: Executes the tag logic: ensures dependencies are wired, retrieves store info, formats the price, and writes to output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Defines behavior at the end of the tag processing, here simply continues page processing.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Setter for the price value to be formatted.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Getter for the current price value.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Getter for the currency used for formatting.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Setter for the currency used for formatting.
